track_name_mapping.notes: LMU track name; both committed references carry track_id algarve-international-circuit.

alignment.notes: Centreline traced from the committed DKR reference lap. Cross-check: the Vista AF Corse LMP2 reference (1:46.279) sits mean 3.3 m / median 3.5 m / p95 5.5 m / max 6.4 m from this centreline across 500 samples, so the +/-5 m shell is not wider than the two drivers' lines disagree.

visual_qa.notes: Automated static-outline tests pass; live by-eye confirmation pending.

caveats: Constant +/-5m shell is synthetic, not measured track limits.
Centerline follows a racing line (LMP3 reference), not the geometric track centre.
Second reference (LMP2) sits p95 5.5 m / max 6.4 m from this centreline, so a few metres of that driver's line fall outside the +/-5 m shell at the widest points.
No TUMFTM data for Portimao in the repo; upgrade needs OSM or satellite widths.
No turn anchors baked: both committed Algarve coaching models use auto-generated turn names, so map labels would be noise until the model is curated.
